title: The fix for M3: the mind in a browser tab, held to its route, and used where the keyword rule finds nothing
sealed: Before any Phase 5b code: core/phase5b/ holds only this file at the commit that adds it, and core/phase5/mind-tab.mjs, core/mind.mjs and core/phase5/page.mjs are as Phase 5 measured them (fall-kit 498d60c). The rules below do not change once the first number is measured.
why: Phase 5's M3 failed: in a real tab, WebLLM's 4-bit Llama 3.2 1B began the sealed reply and kept writing fields nobody asked for until the sealed 24 tokens cut it off, so 30 of 70 replies were not JSON; it routed 25 of 70 right, and with it awake the site routed 44, below the keyword rule alone (46). Read before this seal: of the 30 cut-off replies, 18 had begun with the right route, 9 with a wrong one, 3 with none, so holding the reply to its route alone would put the mind near 43, still under the keyword rule. Two changes follow, each measured as its own claim.
changes: Generation: the tab's mind is asked with a JSON schema that allows exactly one field, route, whose value is one of the seven (WebLLM 0.2.79 response_format { type: json_object, schema }). The prompt, the options (temperature 0, 24 tokens, seed 0) and the mind's door (core/mind.mjs proposal) are unchanged.

Policy: the site routes a message by the keyword rule where the rule finds at least one of its words in it, and by the mind only where it finds none; if the mind then says nothing usable, the route is none. Phase 5's policy (the mind first, the keyword rule where the mind says nothing usable) is kept, by name, for comparison.
honest: This policy was chosen after Phase 5's numbers were seen (the keyword rule was strong, the browser mind weak), so it is judged on a fresh set of 70 messages, sealed here before any is measured: written by the same local model (qwen2.5:7b, temperature 0.8) with a new seed, 2027, from the same route descriptions, the first ten lines per route that are not one of Phase 5's sealed messages. They are not real visitors' words.
B2 re-asks Phase 5's 70 sealed messages, so it tests the generation fix on data already seen; nothing about the prompt or the door was tuned to them.

policy.name: keywords-first
policy.fallback: the mind where the keyword rule finds no word; none if the mind says nothing usable

written.prompt: Phase 5's generation prompt, word for word
written.kept: the first ten lines per route, after trimming white space, leading list marks and surrounding quotation marks, that are not (ignoring case) one of Phase 5's sealed messages

claims.claim: Held to its route, the mind in a tab always gives a proposal.
claims.measure: Phase 5's 70 sealed messages in a real tab of the live page, WebLLM 0.2.79 and Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct-q4f16_1-MLC, the sealed prompt and options, and the schema above; every reply through the mind's door.
claims.rule: 70 messages with Phase 5's sealed digest; 70 of 70 replies a proposal; 0 routes outside the seven

claims.claim: Held to its route, the mind in a tab clears Phase 5's bar.
claims.rule: the mind's own proposal right for at least 49 of 70
claims.predicted: fails: the routes the cut-off replies began with put it near 43

claims.claim: With the keyword rule first and the mind for what it misses, the site in a tab routes clearly better than the keyword rule alone, on messages nobody tuned for.
claims.measure: The 70 fresh messages in a real tab of the live page, the mind held to its route; the keyword-first policy, against the keyword rule alone on the same messages.
claims.rule: 70 fresh messages with the sealed digest; keyword-first right at least 7 more than the keyword rule alone; 0 routes outside the seven

claims.claim: Keyword-first routes at least as well as Phase 5's mind-first, on the fresh messages.
claims.measure: The same run: the mind's reply to every fresh message, decided both ways.
claims.rule: keyword-first right at least as often as mind-first

claims.measure: Phase 5's measure re-run at the Phase 5b commit.
claims.rule: Phase 5's receipt reproduces byte for byte

claims.claim: The new policy never routes outside the seven and never throws.
claims.measure: 20,000 fuzzed replies with random messages, from a fixed seed, through the keyword-first policy.
claims.rule: 20,000 cases, 0 routes outside the seven, 0 throws
